findings.title: Release identity is stale: attestation commit 9125913 != HEAD 38b34a9
findings.note: Mechanism fixed by SEC-P1-001; the attestation content is stale at this HEAD.
findings.recommendation: Capture a fresh owner detached signature over the canonical identity at the released commit + migration head (0057) and the built image digests.

findings.title: Low-severity credential-to-admin chain (no rotation + no admin rate limit + mode disclosure)
findings.recommendation: Prioritise the SECRET-P2-001 fail-closed fix and METRICS_TOKEN rotation; add an admin rate limit.

findings.title: [PORT] 20 evidence/ files committed with mixed line endings
findings.note: False-positive-by-design: evidence is append-only and hash-pinned.
findings.recommendation: Leave evidence bytes untouched (MANIFEST.sha256 pins them); adjust the deterministic check to skip `-text` paths instead of flagging them.

findings.title: Only apps/web is linted; four workspaces have no lint script
findings.recommendation: Add eslint config + lint scripts to the remaining workspaces and make `npm run lint` cover all of them.

findings.title: Large generated evidence artifacts inflate the repository
findings.note: Evidence is append-only by doctrine; recorded as owner-accepted.
findings.recommendation: Archive large generated exports outside git (LFS/object store) and keep only manifests/hashes in-tree.

findings.title: Evidence tree dominates the repository by file count and size
findings.note: Size is intentional append-only evidence; recorded as owner-accepted.
findings.recommendation: Move multi-MB generated exports to Git LFS or an artifact store, keeping only the hash-pinned ledgers in-tree; keep the append-only rule for ledgers.

findings.title: docs/SUPPLY_CHAIN.md is stale against the shipped supply-chain gates
findings.recommendation: Update docs/SUPPLY_CHAIN.md to the current blocking posture and note the cleared grpc-js advisory.

findings.title: Empty service-role key silently disables trusted persistence
findings.recommendation: Fail boot/readiness when NODE_ENV=production and the service-role key is empty; add a readiness sub-check for the service client.

findings.title: Admin mutations have no rate limit or step-up authentication
findings.recommendation: Add a per-actor admin rate limit and require re-validation for high-impact mutations (refund, rollover, teardown).

findings.title: AGENTS.md does not reference the audit-pack / full-domain workflow
findings.recommendation: Add a short 'audits' pointer in AGENTS.md to docs/audits and the evidence doctrine.

findings.title: Anonymous performance sampling has no runtime consent/retention gate
findings.recommendation: Enforce sampling/retention in code (or document the legal basis) and surface the current rate in the privacy notice.

findings.title: Public operational endpoints are unauthenticated and unversioned
findings.recommendation: Serve only the minimum public subset and add an explicit contract version or deprecation window.

findings.title: /config exposes rollout-mode values to unauthenticated clients
findings.recommendation: Restrict /config to the fields the client actually needs, or gate it behind the metrics/ops token.

findings.title: Authoritative room/lobby state is process-local and lost on restart
findings.note: Prior ARCH-P2-003; the publish-override half is now durable.
findings.recommendation: Document the maintenance-window expectation in the deploy runbook, and drain rooms before recreate (stop_grace_period is 30s).

findings.title: BRANCH_PROTECTION.md runbook lists a stale required-check set
findings.recommendation: Update the runbook's required-check list (or make it reference the policy file as the single source).

findings.title: Live branch protection not verified in this read-only pass
findings.recommendation: Run the live audit with an admin token and store the raw PASS output under evidence/.

findings.title: CODEOWNERS is a personal account; required review is a single point
findings.recommendation: Replace with an organisation team handle once the repo moves under the org; document the fallback reviewer.

findings.title: App images use local mutable tags with no in-repo digest binding
findings.recommendation: Have the release job write the built image digests into the attestation evidence and verify them at deploy.

findings.title: Live production schema state unverified in this audit
findings.recommendation: Capture a live `migration list`/schema-head export into evidence at the release commit, bound like the existing attested head.

findings.title: [SUPPLY] 2 container images without a digest pin
findings.note: False-positive: locally built images, not registry pulls.
findings.recommendation: Keep the documented out-of-band released-digest record (LAUNCH_ATTESTED_IMAGES) and the docs/runbooks/DEPLOY.md refresh step.

findings.title: AGENTS.md migration range is stale (0056 vs head 0057)
findings.recommendation: Update the range (or reference the directory/manifest) so the head is not duplicated in prose.

findings.title: Latest backup/restore drill evidence is not committed
findings.recommendation: Run and commit a dated restore drill transcript (append-only) and reference it from the release gate.

findings.title: No ADR records the supply-chain/attestation hardening decision
findings.recommendation: Add an ADR for the detached-attestation and SBOM/supply-chain policy so the rationale is durable.

findings.title: No application-layer maximum replay size bound
findings.recommendation: Reject ghosts above a documented byte ceiling at admission, with a test, and reflect it in the bucket policy.

findings.title: Operational reliability drills are not exercised per release
findings.recommendation: Bind one restore drill + one tabletop to each release candidate and append the transcripts.

findings.title: Committed host crontab references out-of-repo paths/binaries
findings.recommendation: Bring the referenced host scripts (watchdog, backup, tunnel) under infra/ops/ or record their hashes as prerequisites.

findings.title: Committed launch attestation commit is stale versus repository HEAD
findings.recommendation: Re-run the owner attestation at the released HEAD (see FINAL-P1-001).

findings.title: No committed incident tabletop exercise for the current revision
findings.recommendation: Run a tabletop, capture the transcript append-only, and link it from the release gate.

findings.title: PWA manifest provides only an SVG icon (no raster/maskable PNG)
findings.recommendation: Add a 512x512 PNG maskable icon alongside the SVG and validate installability in the mobile journey.

findings.title: User notification preferences are recorded but never delivered
findings.recommendation: Either label preferences as 'future' in the UI or implement a delivery path with opt-in, retry, and a delivery log.

findings.title: Metrics are process-local; durable history depends on the snapshot timer
findings.recommendation: Make the snapshot timer mandatory in production compose/readiness and document the retention horizon.

findings.title: No performance regression gate on pull requests
findings.recommendation: Add a bounded frame-budget/capacity smoke gate to CI (or required check) with a documented threshold.

findings.title: Account-erasure cascade not covered by a SQL negative test
findings.recommendation: Add an account-deletion cascade negative test to supabase/tests and run it in the migrations job.

findings.title: Release notes/changelog are maintained manually
findings.recommendation: Add a generator (e.g. conventional-commits or git-cliff) and wire it to the release process.

findings.title: Rollout-switch rollback requires a process restart
findings.recommendation: Document the restart-based rollback SLO and consider a durable, hot-applied override for the highest-risk switch.

findings.title: Claim-less SQL callers are treated as trusted by social_guard_*
findings.recommendation: Make the trusted branch require an explicit service-role assertion rather than the absence of claims; add a negative test.

findings.title: SBOM is a 90-day CI artifact, not bound to the release attestation
findings.recommendation: Publish the SBOM (and its hash) to a durable release location and reference it from the launch attestation identity.

findings.title: Registry signature verification is continue-on-error (provenance not blocking)
findings.recommendation: Track an owner decision/timebox and promote npm audit signatures to blocking once the upstream attestation issue clears.

findings.title: Ops/METRICS_TOKEN compared non-constant-time and has no rotation path
findings.recommendation: Use crypto.timingSafeEqual over equal-length buffers and document METRICS_TOKEN rotation alongside the other host secrets.

findings.title: METRICS_TOKEN has no rotation path
findings.recommendation: Document METRICS_TOKEN rotation and use a constant-time compare.

findings.title: Local verify-all gate is weaker than the CI pipeline
findings.recommendation: Add a `verify-all --ci-parity` mode or document the exact gap in AGENTS.md so the local claim is bounded.

findings.title: ESLint react-hooks/exhaustive-deps warning in the main game shell
findings.recommendation: Fix the dependency array or add a documented eslint-disable with justification.
